About Hypersynergism

A community mod for Synergism. Originally created by ahvonenj, now maintained by Ferlieloi, maenhiir and contributors.

The original style

This guide adapts the original Hypersynergism website: the dark background, resource icons, compact colored tabs and straightforward text layout.

The original website CSS is retained with responsive and accessibility additions. The game-inspired images come from the original site's resources; Synergism artwork belongs to its respective creators. Neither the mod nor this guide is an official game website.

Privacy

This documentation site uses no analytics, cookies, account system or game-save uploads. Search runs in your browser. Following external links uses those services.

License & acknowledgements

The repository's MIT license and upstream credits are retained. Documentation describes the audited source; availability can vary with progression, platform and game patches.
